contents.text: {"answer":"Engineering should first examine the rear-camera wiring where it passes through the tailgate, focusing on whether normal tailgate movement pinches, wears or severs the wires. The owner reports this mechanism, and an earlier owner similarly described wires wearing through as the two-way tailgate opened and closed. Treat this as a failure mechanism to verify, not a confirmed engineering diagnosis.","scope":"answered","citations":[{"kind":"complaint","id":"11443328","quote":"normal tailgate use pinches the wires and eventually they become damaged, severing the connection and disabling the rear camera"},{"kind":"earlier_complaint","id":"11437880","quote":"Opening and closing of the two-way tailgate, over time, have worn through the wires."}],"recheck":false}
